title: Read a Dockerfile
summary: A Dockerfile describes how to build an image. FROM chooses a base; COPY adds a file from the build folder.
introduction: A Dockerfile describes how to build an image. FROM chooses a base; COPY adds a file from the build folder. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A Dockerfile describes how to build an image. FROM chooses a base; COPY adds a file from the build folder.
The planned image starts with Nginx and adds your static index.html. Put the Dockerfile beside that file.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a tiny index.html that says Reading club.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not COPY secret files into an image; image layers can retain them.
For more detail later, use this [Docker further reading](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/).

seo.title: Docker: Read a Dockerfile
seo.description: Learn about read a dockerfile in Docker. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
